title: Privacy Policy
description: Learn how AfriNuts collects, uses, and protects your personal information. We are committed to transparency, privacy, and safeguarding your data when you interact with our services.

collection.title: 1. What Information We Collect
collection.description: We may collect the following information when you interact with our services:
items: Personal details such as your name, email address, phone number, and company information when you contact us or request a quote
Technical information from your browser or device, including IP address, browser type, operating system, and cookies
Usage data such as pages visited, time spent on our website, and interactions with content
Information you provide voluntarily through surveys, newsletters, or feedback forms
collection.note: We only collect information that is necessary for providing our services and improving your experience.

use.title: 2. How We Use Your Information
use.description: Your data is used for legitimate business purposes only, including:
items: Responding to inquiries and providing requested services or quotes
Improving website performance, functionality, and user experience
Sending newsletters, promotional updates, or service notifications if you have opted in
Analyzing trends and usage to optimize our offerings and communications
Compliance with legal obligations and protecting AfriNuts against fraud or misuse
use.note: We do not sell, rent, or trade your personal information to third parties.

cookies.title: 3. Cookies & Tracking
cookies.description: We use cookies and similar tracking technologies to enhance your experience, analyze website traffic, and understand user behavior.
items: Necessary cookies for basic website functionality
Performance and analytics cookies to measure and improve site performance
Preference cookies to remember your choices and settings
Optional marketing cookies for personalized content (only if you consent)
cookies.note: You can manage or disable cookies in your browser settings, but some features may be affected.

security.title: 4. Data Security
security.description: We implement robust technical, administrative, and organizational measures to protect your personal information against unauthorized access, loss, or misuse, including:
items: Encryption of sensitive data in transit and at rest
Regular system and network security updates
Access controls and staff training on data protection
Monitoring and response procedures for potential security breaches

rights.title: 5. Your Rights
rights.description: You have the following rights regarding your personal data:
items: Access your personal information
Request corrections to inaccurate data
Request deletion of your personal information where permitted by law
Withdraw consent for marketing communications at any time
Object to or restrict processing of your personal data
rights.note: We respond to requests in accordance with applicable data protection laws, including the right to lodge a complaint with the relevant supervisory authority.

thirdPartyServices.title: 6. Third-Party Services
thirdPartyServices.description: We may use trusted third-party services for analytics, marketing, and hosting. These services are bound by privacy agreements and cannot use your data for unrelated purposes.

childrenPrivacy.title: 7. Children's Privacy
childrenPrivacy.description: Our website and services are not directed to individuals under 18 years of age. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children.

changes.title: 8. Changes to this Policy
changes.description: AfriNuts may update this Privacy Policy periodically. Changes will be posted on this page with an updated 'Last Updated' date. Continued use of our services constitutes acceptance of the updated policy.
